# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Nimpayo obukaiso, Ai Ruhanga wange, ngu niwe wampangire nkuramye kandi nkumanye, nindanga omukasumi kanu, mu bugara bwange kandi mu buguuda bwawe. Busaho Ruhanga ondi, Kwihaho iwe wenka, Omukonyezi omukabi, Anyakwomeera. Oromo, Borana-Arsi-Guji - ኦሮሚኛ (Orominya, Oromigna, Afan Oromo, Galla, Galligna,
